name: Oenomaus
bio: Oenomaus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors records the poet's date as unknown.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 749).

poems.title: Book IX, 749: On Love carved on a Bowl
poems.author: Oenomaus
poems.text: Why Love on the bowl? It is enough for the heart to be set on fire by wine. Add not fire to fire.
